decisive_spans.text: Pleural fluid analysis: protein 3.5 g/dL; LDH 1413 U/L; glucose 98 mg/dL; ADA 31.4 U/L; total cell count 100/mm3 (10% neutrophils, 90% lymphocytes); amylase 11,871 U/L

response.rationale: Both D1 and D4 are very similar diagnoses. D1 is slightly more specific by including 'due to pancreaticopleural fistula' which is strongly supported by the very high pleural fluid amylase and the history of pancreatitis and pancreatic cysts. D4 is a more general diagnosis of 'Pulmonary effusion due to pancreaticopleural fistula' which is also strongly supported, but D1 is more precise.
